checks: Seven unique weapon configurations, distinct timings/styles, six melee light attacks hit only once per swing and no normal one-shots
Heavy windup is harmless before active window; twin heavy has exactly two defined impact windows
Held frontal guard reduces damage without repeated automatic parries; fresh130ms parry interrupts and opens riposte; back attacks bypass guard
Directional dodge avoids timed swing and consumes stamina/cooldown rather than allowing permanent invulnerability
Bow charge/release creates a moving gravity projectile, one ammo; pillars stop it and retain a brief stuck arrow; cancellation never fires
Six melee specials functional, sword riposte gated; spear charge cannot teleport or damage through pillar
Axe spin can hit front and back opponents once each, rather than damage every rotation frame
Simultaneous final deaths restart a real duel; equal top scores enter contender tiebreak; survivor winner is explicit; survival gap exceeds all possible kill bonuses
Sudden-death circle advances progressively; fixed-step clock/movement invariant at60vs20 render updates; visible solid geometry blocks movement/LOS and has navigable routes
Piercing bow special damages at most three consecutive targets, consumes preparation, and stops before the fourth
Three complete round transitions reset combat state, reopen selection, aggregate scores and finish with the actual top scorer
